item.title: Thatcher Effect – Optical Illusion and Explanation
item.description:
📝 My favorite is this [2] paper from 2009, showing that monkeys experience the same effect. This again, does make sense, but the fact that they did the study itself is really the surprise. When a face is shown upside down, the brain can’t really use its same mechanisms but instead will look at the individual features and process them as they are.
🔗 Read more: https://optical.toys/thatcher-effect/
